observation.visible_scene: A man wearing a dark patterned long-sleeve shirt, blue jeans and sandals sits in the driver position of a homemade open-frame solar-electric vehicle: a black tubular chassis with a blue-tinted angled windshield, a tilted solar-panel canopy mounted above and behind him, red coil-over suspension springs, small road wheels, a sloped front hood, a blue-and-red dashboard console, and a black battery box on the floor behind the seat. He grips a black steering wheel with red accents, legs stretched forward, while the vehicle travels along a paved road lined by a striped concrete barrier, green foliage and stacked logs; a truck passes in the background during the middle of the clip.
visible_changes: The camera viewpoint moves continuously from a front three-quarter angle (windshield and front wheel dominant, the driver's face largely hidden behind the reflective blue panel) toward a rear three-quarter angle (the driver's clear side profile, the blue dashboard console with a round gauge, the full cell grid of the solar canopy, and the rear wheel become visible).
The solar canopy changes from a thin edge-on strip to a broad surface showing its grid purely as the viewing angle shifts; the panel itself does not move.
The windshield shifts from reflecting sky and trees to being seen through, revealing the driver and then the dashboard, consistent with the changing angle rather than a change in the glass.

The background scrolls past (logs, barrier, greenery) and a blue truck with motion blur crosses behind the vehicle in the mid-frames, indicating relative motion between the vehicle and its surroundings.
The wheel spokes show rotational blur, consistent with the vehicle rolling forward throughout.
The driver stays seated with hands on the wheel the whole time; only small head/gaze adjustments are visible.
outside_clip_unknowns: How and when the drive started or ends; what propels the vehicle (no motor operation is visible).
Whether the camera rides on a separate moving vehicle or tracks handheld.
The vehicle's actual speed and the route beyond this excerpt.
uncertain_details: Whether the apparent change of viewpoint is the camera orbiting the vehicle or the vehicle negotiating a curve.
Whether the seat is a single unit or a two-passenger bench (the backrest shows two cushion sections).
The exact function of the round gauge/screen on the dashboard.
